title: calliandra geminata
intro: Calliandra geminata, commonly known as the "powder puff tree", is a species of flowering plant in the family Fabaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Calliandra geminata include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent, making it useful in the management of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
